s.note: Crisp baked potato skins loaded with melted cheddar, sour cream, spring onion and jalapeño
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick 6 medium potatoes and bake for an hour until tender, then cool for 10 minutes. Halve and scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a 5mm wall (keep the flesh for mash). Brush the skins inside and out with 2 tbsp olive oil, season with 1 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp pepper and 0.5 tsp smoked paprika and roast for 15 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Fill with 150g grated cheddar and bake 5 minutes more until melted. Top with 150g sour cream, 3 sliced spring onions and 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapeños.

s.note: Peanuts, cashews and pretzels roasted with butter, brown sugar, smoked paprika and cayenne
s.how: Heat the oven to 160C. Mix 40g melted butter with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 0.5 tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Toss with 200g raw peanuts, 150g raw cashews and 100g pretzels and spread on a lined tray. Roast for 25 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until golden. Cool on the tray until crisp.

m.note: Double smashed beef patties with melted cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce on toasted buns
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls and keep cold. Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp yellow mustard and 1 tbsp pickle brine. Toast the cut sides of 4 soft burger buns in 20g butter. Heat a heavy pan or flat plate until very hot. Working in batches, put in the balls, top each with a little very finely sliced onion and smash flat with a sturdy spatula. Season with salt and pepper, cook 2 minutes until deeply browned, flip, top with a slice of cheese and cook 1 minute more. Build the buns with sauce, shredded lettuce, two patties each and sliced dill pickles.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a raspberry swirl and a crackly top
w.how: Heat the oven to 175C and line a 20cm square tin. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 250g caster sugar with 3 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla for 4 minutes until pale and thick. Fold in the chocolate, then 80g plain flour, 30g cocoa and a pinch of salt. Pour into the tin, dot with 2 tbsp raspberry jam and 125g raspberries and swirl with a skewer. Bake for 28 minutes until just set in the middle, then cool completely in the tin before cutting into 16.

d.n: Macher house cherry rum and cola
d.note: Dark rum over ice with muddled cherries and lime, topped with cola
d.how: Divide 150g pitted cherries and the juice of 1 lime between 4 tall glasses and muddle. Fill with ice, add 45ml dark rum to each, top with 800ml cold cola, stir and finish with a lime wedge.
